scope: Typed DIMSTYLE DIMTXTDIRECTION output at AC1024 and later

evidence.code: dxfRW::writeDimstyle now emits the typed DRW_Dimstyle::dimtxtdirection field through writeBool(295) when the target is AC1024+ and no dynamic group-295 value has already been selected. This fills the typed-only gap while preserving dynamic-variable precedence.

references.title: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files
references.observation: DIMTXTDIRECTION is mapped to field code 295.

references.title: Autodesk DIMTXTDIRECTION system variable
references.observation: Default is 0; value controls dimension text reading direction.

evidence.control: libdxfrw_dimstyle_table_allocation writes a typed value of 1 at AC1024 in ASCII and Binary; ASCII record scanning confirms group 295 is in the DIMSTYLE row, and fresh parser readback confirms dimtxtdirection == 1.
evidence.fixture_policy: Generated controls write only to the system temporary directory; no DWG or DXF fixture added to the repository.
limits: This proves field serialization and self-readback only, not application-level dimension appearance.
Group 295 remains refused for older targets when nondefault; no older spelling is assumed.
